title: Sentinel Timer Webhook Payload
description: Payload schema for timer webhook endpoints. POST /api/webhooks/timers is create-only and requires id/system_id/expires_at. PATCH /api/webhooks/timers/{id} is partial-update and uses path id as target. If payload id is sent on PATCH, it must match the path id.

id.description: External timer identifier. Required on POST create. Optional on PATCH update, but must match path id when present. Stored as webhook_id.

title.description: Optional. Defaults to the resolved system name on create when omitted.

system_id.description: Required on create. Update requests target an existing timer via path id.

timer_kind.description: Timer type. Valid with structure_type/stage_label only when the business-rule context matrix is satisfied (see docs/timer-webhook.md, section 'Timer Context Rules').

structure_type.description: Optional on update. Required on create for a valid timer context. Specific allowed stage_label values depend on timer_kind and structure_type (see docs/timer-webhook.md, section 'Timer Context Rules').

stage_label.description: Optional on update. Required on create for a valid timer context. The accepted value also depends on timer_kind and structure_type (see docs/timer-webhook.md, section 'Timer Context Rules').

planet_id.description: Optional. If provided without planet_name, Sentinel will try to fill the name from local SDE cache.

planet_name.description: Optional display field. If omitted and planet_id is known locally, Sentinel fills it automatically.

moon_id.description: Optional. If provided without moon_name, Sentinel will try to fill the name from local SDE cache.

moon_name.description: Optional display field. If omitted and moon_id is known locally, Sentinel fills it automatically.

owner_corporation_id.description: Optional. If provided without name/ticker, Sentinel will try to fill them from local org cache and may fall back to public ESI.

owner_corporation_name.description: Optional display field. If omitted and owner_corporation_id is available, Sentinel fills it automatically from cache or public ESI.

owner_corporation_ticker.description: Optional display field. If omitted and owner_corporation_id is available, Sentinel fills it automatically from cache or public ESI.

owner_alliance_id.description: Optional. If provided without name/ticker, Sentinel will try to fill them from local org cache and may fall back to public ESI.

owner_alliance_name.description: Optional display field. If omitted and owner_alliance_id is available, Sentinel fills it automatically from cache or public ESI.

owner_alliance_ticker.description: Optional display field. If omitted and owner_alliance_id is available, Sentinel fills it automatically from cache or public ESI.

status.description: Optional. Defaults to active on create and is unchanged on update when omitted.

expires_at.description: Required on create. Optional on patch. UTC timestamp accepted by Sentinel flexible datetime parsing.
